scope: Customer rental duplicate detection and overlapping physical-piece reservations
implemented: Identity-aware quote and final hold reject an overlapping reservation of the same offer or matching product/fitting for the same customer.
An owner conflict links only to that customer's existing booking in the same boutique.
Guest and other-customer conflicts explain booked dates without exposing another customer's identity or booking reference.
The final hold rechecks capacity inside the existing store-fenced MongoDB transaction.
Same-attempt recovery precedes new-booking checks; competing new attempts cannot create an owner duplicate.
Stale quote and pending attempt are cleared on a definitive booking conflict; no automatic charge or bag consumption occurs.
Canceled reservations and expired unpaid holds release dates. Alternate fitting selections and additional real pieces remain independently bookable.

backend.environment: Node 20; isolated transaction-capable MongoDB; managed licence/provider fixtures

browser.api: Real isolated API; original listing photo retained
